full_prompt_en: A square painterly scene shows a man in a burgundy suit seated beside a teal vintage car beneath a dramatic blue sky. Large blue and gray clouds crowd the upper half, their pale edges cut by energetic brush strokes. At the left, the rounded front end and wheel of the car fill the middle and lower background, its glossy teal body interrupted by a dark window and a narrow chrome bumper. On the right, a wooden utility pole and a small pale building recede across a sunlit roadside. The seated man occupies most of the center and foreground. A tan brimmed hat with a dark band shades his face as he turns to his left and looks downward. His dark skin is modeled with warm highlights across the cheek, jaw and clasped hands. The burgundy jacket has broad lapels and closely spaced dark stripes, and a blue shirt, patterned tie and small pocket square are visible beneath it. His elbows rest on his spread knees, with hands linked in front of him. Matching striped trousers break into sharp folds around the thighs and lower legs. Dark socks and polished brown shoes meet the tiled path along the bottom of the frame. The low seat beneath him is partly hidden by his body, but a short vertical support is visible between his legs. Sunlight enters from the upper left and breaks across the shoulder, hands, car body and pavement, while the hat brim and lower folds remain in deeper shade. The storm-colored sky supplies a cool foil for the warm maroon cloth and earth tones. Strong directional strokes, crisp figure edges and rougher clouds give the scene a worked painted surface rather than a flat graphic finish. The overall composition makes the seated figure a compact warm center against a broad cool sky and car, with the roadside details receding into quiet distance.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画场景描绘一位穿酒红西装的男子坐在青绿色老车旁，上方是富有戏剧性的蓝天。大块蓝灰云挤满上半幅，浅色云缘被有力笔触切开。左侧，汽车圆润的车头和车轮填满中下部背景，光亮的青绿色车身被深色车窗和狭窄镀铬保险杠打断。右侧，一根木电线杆与一座浅色小建筑沿受日照的路边退向远方。坐着的男子占据中央与前景大部分。带深色帽带的棕褐色宽檐帽遮住他的脸，他转向左侧并低头望去。深色皮肤由面颊、下颌和交握双手上的暖光塑形。酒红色夹克有宽翻领和紧密深色条纹，里面可见蓝衬衫、花纹领带及小口袋巾。他双肘搁在分开的膝盖上，双手在身前相扣。同色条纹裤在大腿与小腿处折成尖锐褶线。深色袜子与光亮棕鞋接触画面底部的铺砖小径。身下的矮座大部分被身体挡住，但双腿之间可见一段短竖支撑。日光从左上进入，越过肩膀、双手、车身与铺地，帽檐下和裤褶深处则保持浓影。风暴色天空为暖栗红衣料与土色提供冷色对照。有方向性的强笔触、清楚的人物边缘及更粗松的云块使场景具有经过反复描绘的表面，而非平板图形感。整体构图让坐着的人物成为宽阔冷色天空和汽车前紧凑的暖色中心，路边细节安静地退向远处。
style_prompt_en: The image has a forceful painterly surface in which short angular strokes carve form and broad sweeps build the atmosphere. Saturated cool blue and teal fields oppose concentrated wine red, ochre and warm brown areas. Dark contour accents and sharply lit folds hold focal shapes together, while looser broken marks animate the surrounding planes. Light enters from one upper side, setting narrow warm highlights against substantial cool shadow. Reflective surfaces carry small hard glints, whereas soft masses have rougher, more varied brush edges. Strong near forms occupy a compressed foreground, and small receding marks open the distance beyond them. The overall effect is energetic and substantial, with a clear warm-cool division and visible brush rhythm making the volumes feel weighty.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有有力的绘画表面，短促棱角笔触切出形体，宽笔势搭起空气感。饱和冷蓝与青绿色域对照浓缩的酒红、赭黄及暖褐色区域。深轮廓强调和受光的尖锐褶面稳住焦点形体，更松散的断笔痕使周围平面活跃。光从一侧上方进入，在充足冷影旁形成狭窄暖色高光。反射性表面带有小而硬的亮点，柔软的大形体则有更粗松多变的笔触边缘。强烈近景形体占据压缩的前景，远处的小笔痕把纵深打开。整体效果有活力而厚实，清楚的冷暖划分与可见笔触节奏让体积显得有重量。

theme_zh: 一位穿酒红西装的男子坐在青绿色老车旁，头顶是风云涌动的蓝天
name: Ernie Barnes
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
